visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a male with short hair and a female wearing a tan cap and glasses standing on a city street at night. They are both dressed in white traditional-style tunics and are laughing while talking. The background is a bokeh-blurred urban night scene with streetlights and distant buildings. (2) The scene cuts to the trio in front of a food stall. A male interviewee wearing a black t-shirt, an Adidas cap, and a mask stands between them. The male interviewer holds a yellow and blue 'HahaTai' microphone. The interviewee gestures with his hands, which are covered in purple nitrile gloves. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the stall's black and orange sign, which reads 'I'M SO GAY' in large white letters and '鹽酥雞' in orange. A stylized orange chicken head icon is positioned to the left. (4) Back to the medium shot, the interviewee continues to speak, shifting his weight. The female interviewer reacts with exaggerated facial expressions, her mouth wide open in mock surprise. The lighting is bright from the stall's internal overhead lamps. (5) The interviewee pulls out a smartphone and holds it up, seemingly on a speakerphone call. The two interviewers lean in close to the phone, their faces showing intense concentration and then bursts of laughter. (6) In the final phase, the three individuals stand together. The interviewee applies a round green sticker to the stall sign. They then join their hands together in a traditional greeting pose and smile directly at the camera as a graphic overlay appears.
